title: DeployJobsV1
description: Immutable RabbitMQ message contract for the deploy.jobs queue, shared between the server (producer) and worker-server (consumer). This file is the single source of truth. It is immutable once V1 ships: any breaking change is a new version (deploy-jobs-v2.schema.json) shipped alongside V1 for a bounded migration window; this file must never be edited in place.

version.description: Message contract version. The body value is authoritative; the x-contract-version AMQP header is an advisory routing aid.

event_id.description: Unique event identifier. For webhook builds it is the GitHub delivery UUID; for manual builds it is the client idempotency key. Used as the AMQP message_id and for deduplication.

deployment_id.description: Identifies exactly one build run (one deployments row).

project_id.description: Identifies the durable selected/configured project that groups this build's history.

installation_id.description: GitHub App installation ID. Authorization and token scoping derive from it.

clone_url.description: Immutable HTTPS clone source. The worker validates this URL defensively before running git.

commit_sha.description: Full immutable commit SHA. Mandatory and authoritative: the worker checks out this exact commit, never the moving branch head.

requested_ref.description: The ref the build was requested from (branch ref for webhook pushes, user-supplied ref for manual builds). Mutable context only; never identifies a build.

trigger.description: How the build was triggered. Manual and webhook builds are never coalesced.

generation.description: Monotonic project desired-revision generation. Older generations must never become the project's current/latest result after a newer accepted revision.

retry_count.description: Delivery attempt count carried in the message so retries preserve the immutable V1 body.

correlation_id.description: Correlation/request ID. Used as the AMQP correlation_id for tracing.

executable.description: Structured build command executable. Never an arbitrary sh -c string.

working_dir.description: Declared working directory for the build command.

scanner_policy_version.description: Version of the command scanner/policy that approved this configuration snapshot.
